cultural.vision_reason: This is a composite 'lor' dance mask with carved painted wooden face, fiber beard/hair, feather-edged disk, and a painted wooden peacock figure — a known Tolai ceremonial mask type used in dance/ritual.

physical.title: dance-mask ('lor')
physical.summary: Composite 'lor' dance mask: narrow, roughly triangular face of light wood with cut-out eyes, painted in curved horizontal bands of yellow, green, red (chin), white (teeth), purple, yellow, purple (upper face), red nose with wood stick and glass beads ornament, vegetable fibre beard and hair on domed head; above it disk of vegetable fibre, its edge decorated with white feathers; in centre standing peacock figure of painted light wood with outstretched wings and displayed tail, painted in green and red (body), purple (wings), yellow and red (head crest), green, yellow and red (tail); on top of peacock's body vertical pink and orange wood rod, one-third up its height horizontal elliptical white-painted wood board, its edges trimmed with white feathers; at its ends white and red, with green in centre, toothed projections meeting at top of vertical rod and thus forming triangle.
